summary: Marree Airport (RRE/YMRE) serves the remote outback town of Marree in northern South Australia, situated near the famous junction of the Oodnadatta Track and Birdsville Track. Once a bustling hub for the old Ghan railway, Marree is now a small settlement that relies on the airport for fly-in fly-out workers, medical evacuations, and tourists visiting nearby Lake Eyre (Kati Thanda). The medium-sized airfield primarily handles general aviation and charter flights in one of Australia's most isolated regions.
faqs:
Q: Does Marree Airport have scheduled passenger flights?
A: No, Marree Airport does not have regular scheduled commercial service. It operates as a general aviation airfield, supporting charter flights, private aircraft, and emergency services.

Q: Where exactly is Marree located?
A: Marree is in the far north of South Australia, approximately 700 km north of Adelaide, near the junction of the Oodnadatta Track and the Birdsville Track.

Q: What is the closest major attraction to Marree?
A: Kati Thanda–Lake Eyre (Lake Eyre National Park) is the primary attraction, lying to the south and southeast of the township.
